sentence_stem: What surprised the committee most was
correct_completion: how quickly the team had finished the review.
full_sentence: What surprised the committee most was how quickly the team had finished the review.
acceptable_variants: how fast the team had completed the review.
how swiftly the team had finished the review.

options.text: quickly the team finished the review.
options.why_wrong: The adverb is placed before the subject, which is not valid word order inside a wh-clause here.

options.text: so the team finished the review.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result clause and cannot complete the wh-clause that follows 'was'.

options.text: how quickly the team had finished the review.
the review finished the team quickly.
options.why_wrong: Subject and object are reversed; the team finished the review, not the other way round.

grammar_focus: Wh-nominal clauses functioning as subject complements
explanation: After a pseudo-cleft opening such as 'What surprised ... was', the complement must be a wh-clause that answers the question about what was surprising. The clause needs normal subject-verb order and a perfect form to show that the finishing happened before the surprise.
translation: To, co najbardziej zaskoczyło komisję, to jak szybko zespół skończył przegląd.
